block.audio_file_stream.model.title: Audio File Stream
block.audio_file_stream.model.descriptio: Stream completed local WAV and Ogg/Opus files as paced audio, with explicit lifecycle and interruption commands.
block.audio_file_stream.workflow: Send a completed WAV or Ogg/Opus file. Connect audio_out to Speaker and command_out to recorders. Interrupt Speaker separately to clear sound already queued.
block.audio_file_stream.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.audio_file_stream.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.audio_file_stream.help_allowed_roo: Required. Relative file paths are resolved here; files outside this directory and symbolic links are refused.
block.audio_file_stream.help_max_audio_s: A longer file is rejected completely, never silently truncated.
block.audio_file_stream.help_queue_size: One file streams at a time. Additional files wait in this bounded queue; overflow is reported.
block.audio_file_stream.help_max_input_m: Bounds the private source snapshot. Source files are never modified.
block.audio_file_stream.help_prepare_tim: Deadline for copying, validation and local FFmpeg conversion before streaming begins.
block.audio_file_stream.help_bitrate_kbp: PCM16 WAV is converted to 48 kHz Opus. Existing Ogg/Opus packets are remuxed without re-encoding.
